collection.title: Citroen C3 Hatchback 2016 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C3 Hatchback 2016 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this C3 Hatchback which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
